posts.text: Won the Ohio Republican Governor Primary with over 82% of the vote. The people of Ohio spoke loudly. Now it's time to deliver real results — cutting bureaucracy, empowering parents, and making Ohio the best state in America.

posts.text: Proud to see the growing Indian American voice in shaping America's future. Our community's values — hard work, education, family — are exactly what this country needs more of.
